posts.h:
Vega



"Vega" usually means the Blue and the Ice Celestial Being. Which explains why the map is based on some Cyan and Ice theme. Another quick note is that this is a sequel of a map, "Crimson".

Story:

Mr. Elec and the Blue Box Alliance has finally won the battle over Mr. Box and the Red Box Alliance. The Blue Box Alliance shuts down the facility and destroyed the Crimson Heart Gem where the Red Box Alliance will never get their own energy harvested from the Underworld in the future. Mr. Elec and his team gathered and snatched completely all of the capsules where it contains the harvested energy from the Underworld and bring them safely back to their own base. However the main problem is that they don't know what to do with the energy. They tried to put the power surge on energy-drained machine, but instead of working just right it explodes and causes an extreme malfunction. So, Mr. Elec also hired his own scientists and experts to find a way to make these energy usable and have the right compatibility for their machine. The scientists has discovered that the energy that they harvested from the Underworld is extremely unstable, so they will have to find a way to make it stable. But that's why they then decided to create a facility where they now find a way to make these energy stable and usable. And that's why and how the Vega facility is born, by using an highly-advanced cooling system and powerful stirling cryogenerator to cool of the energy and allows them to be stable and usable successfully. Now they have their own perfect and powerful energy ready to use for their own base and the Blue Box Alliance. But, one of the Red Box Alliance's scout has heard the news of their own stable energies and cooling system. So, the Red Box Alliance decided to go to battle against the Blue Box Alliance once again to reclaim their energy that they harvested for their own base as well. Who will finally claim the perfect, and the powerful energy from the Underworld?


Facts:


  • Modes: Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, and Zombie.
  • Bricks: 16,848 Standard Bricks + 2,396 Special Bricks = 19,244 Bricks.
  • Apparently there is no portals, but there are many paths that you can go to avoid enemy's attacks and location. Really good for running and gunning!
  • There's no such thing "Tactic Skills" in the map like this!
  • Download price: 350 Force-Points.
  • Version: 2 (the first registered map was deleted because I made some huge mistake on the ventilation system.)


Screenshots:












I hope you can enjoy the map and the design of the map I did. It took a lot of thinking and some designing ideas to make this map really fun the play with. If the Decorative and Function bricks were unlimited, then it would be much more.. "cooler". Please send me a feedback or your impression about this map!

I'll see you guys at the battlefield and at the forum!

- Kagome

Tangelo



Tangelo usually means the combination or the hybrid of tangerine and grapefruit. But Tangelo also means the mixture color of most other orange colors. Really clever name with a reason. And that's right, everywhere you look is mostly orange.


Story:

Once there was two prince of the Brick-Persian Empire named Hiomata and Gaarra. They were once a peaceful and great brothers and the prince of their own Empire. After many times of their peaceful day and keeping their Empire safe and secured, there was a group of children who are carrying a bright and shiny, orange gems that is a bit gooey but sweet and tasty! They named this Amber Candy. The children show the princes where they found these strange and rare candy but it's not quite far however. As time passes by they have found a huge piles of sands and pillars, covered in thick and hard, orange rocks and sands... Hiomata brought construction men to clean up and remove the natural coverage to discover what's behind these sands and rocks; Gaarra brought geologists and soldiers to scavenge, discover and study these candies... or minerals... Many days and nights passes as they continue to dig and uncover the secret of what the sands and rocks are covering at until they have found out it was an ancient, mythological temple with rich orange and white texture... There's a large machine or an unknown object, but as the sun shines above the object, it begins to power up and absorb the solar energy from the sun. The pillars begins to gather and combine the solar energy it gathers with a dust of an unknown sand they have found... The center of the bottom temple begins to light up a powerful, blazing flame where on top of it are glass that begins to produce a gooey, orange substances from the middle. As the gooey substance falls down from the ceiling then enters the fire, it begins to harden as it then shines a bright, orange mineral but still gooey, resulting on becoming an Amber Candy.. The princes then tasted the candy as they find it really sweet and delicious! And even the geologist discovers that these mineral are worth 5,000 Tokens per kilo! They found themselves rich with such gift from a God that they believe in from their empire! But, Hiomata believes that they should not take this such expensive and rare minerals that this temple produces, he believes that it's best to return these minerals to the temple. But, Gaarra disagrees as he believes that it's best to produce and harvest many minerals as much as they can until they ran out to be filthy rich for their empire! The two princes begins to argue on which of these two princes would be considered doing the good things and the bad things. The two princes then raised their army as they begin to battle and determine which prince will be considered the prince that is right and wrong. Will Hiomata prevent them stealing such rich and delicious mineral from the ancient temple? Or will Gaarra manage to claim and complete his looting from the temple?

Facts:


  • Modes: Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, and Zombie.
  • Bricks: 13,280 Standard Bricks + 1,953 Special Bricks = 15,233 Bricks.
  • There is no portals, but there is lots of explosives barrels in case for emergency! Use them only when needed to!
  • This is all about real teamwork, speed and accuracy! All teams have a chance to win fairly.

Story:
Previously, in Vega, Mr. Box and the Red Box Alliance has finally claim their energy back thanks to the Vega facility from Mr. Elec's and the Blue Box Alliance (phew! You thought Mr. Box would lose?) But, the battle between Mr. Box's Red Box Alliance and Mr. Elec's Blue Box Alliance continues. They battle over the energy harvest from the Underworld, they battle over the cooled down and refined energy from the extreme cooling system, what's next that they must claim for such energy for their people?! A powerful nuclear reactor that be risky that is capable of blowing up the whole galaxy? Maybe. 10 years later after the defeat by the Red Box Alliance, Mr. Elec decided to create their own energy production facility:Which is of course they decided to use the stars for their extreme and risky thermal plant facility! They first absorb and grab any nearby starts by activating the magnetizing tower that attracts and captures any nearby stars. Doesn't matter how hot or how big the star is, it will be attracted... but the sun doesn't count. As the absorbed and attracted stars approaches near the tower, it begins to sucks in but slowly. Thanks to the 4 Low-Gravity Bauble things, we can quickly grab many thermal sources we can harvest from a slowly drifted stars as they then deposit down, making the stars to shine less and be less hotter than before.If they keep on doing this, more stars becomes powerless and not very easy to see from the surface! And that's why the Galactic Defense Starforces approaches to solve the incident of many stars becoming powerless! Now it's the clash between Mr. Elec's Blue Box Alliance versus the Galactic Defense Starforces. Will Mr. Elec claim their own energy of their desire? Or will the Galactic Defense Starforces will prevent them consuming more powerful stars?

Facts:


  • Modes: Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, and Zombie.
  • Bricks: 8,196 Standard Bricks + 2,819 Special Bricks = 11,015 Bricks.

  • The map is all about speed, agility, and parkour! Use your gravity and good memory of the map pattern's to easily find a way to avoid enemy's attacks and approaches faster!
  • There are many paths you can go in many different levels of the map! There are also mostly lots of ladders that you may trust on to use it for an ambush or tactical attacks.

Emerald



"Here is the place where the Brick-Soldiers and Brickmen love to hang out and relax on this peaceful spot with their friends and family. But they are unaware of what dark secret lies beneath the pure, beautiful nature's gift."


Story:

June 4, 2014.
During the war between the Korean and the Chinese forces, innocent civilians and scientists evacuated to a safe location where it was guarded and protected by the American and German soldiers. The West accepts and allow the innocent of the East civilians to stay and hide away from the enemy forces until the war is over. The Americans and the Germans allow them to stay in their designated small hill-like mountain, unaware that there was an abandoned laboratory hiding underneath the inn that is located at the top center of the mountain. The scientists later discover the path that leads them to a secret abandoned laboratory. With an forbidden ingredients and blueprints hidden away along with the abandoned laboratory that the scientists had studied and found, they developed a specialized chemical which allows them to grow and fertilize plants in a great succession rate, which turned out successful flawlessly.

June 12, 2014.
The scientists then discovered an unusual and a secret blueprints and machine that was abandoned for about few hundreds years. This new "Chemical and Machine" causes the natural vegetation to grow rapidly and grow in abnormal state, but also causes a powerful disease and a virus that can harm any Brickmen but grow any plants in rapid paste and evolving them to an unbelievable plant species. This have now later on, calls on the Zombie Virus Outbreak.

Today.
Two sudden separate Special Operation team dispatched to investigate and claim the "treasure" that is hidden on a secret laboratory and return safely to their base. But all they find was a source of a Zombie Virus and all they can do now is to fight for their lives or work together to find a cure of this obnoxious, menacing Zombie Virus. Are you here to fight for your lives? Or are you here to finally put an end to this Zombie Virus?

Information:

  • Also a good place to hang out and have fun with your friends (To those who wanted to throw a party or don't want to fight but to relax.)
